name: services/housing/unused_assignment_ids
description:
Get a list of assignment IDs which were not checked-in yet. The list if filtered by dormitory and allocation period.

This method can be used by dormitory administrators to find the users who didn't check in into the dormitory. Only dormitory admins may access this list.
brief_description: Get a list of assignments which were not checked-in yet.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.
